reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: ATP/load angular and simulation study, conditional torque/power and optional nucleotide reporters; no work/free-energy comparison.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.
Static angular thresholds and synthetic error rates are described, but there is no numerical false-call/recovery or temporal acceptance-to-action rule for the main event detector.

Correct independent-preparation/chamber/molecule hierarchy is present, but the sample-size pilot does not specify a quantitative precision/power target linked to meaningful effect and between-preparation variance.
Technical exclusions are logged but no registered full-sample/precision/finite extension stopping rule or original inspected inactive-molecule denominator is supplied.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

checks.quote: If the enzyme can be locked or inhibited
checks.reason: Free rotational diffusion D=kBT/drag cannot be applied to an enzyme-locked, elastically confined probe without identifying the short-time free regime or fitting confinement/compliance. A rigid locked object does not freely diffuse; the stated empirical drag estimator lacks this correction.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

checks.quote: Invariant step size with slowed dwells supports discrete power strokes
checks.reason: Preferred step angles, backward fluctuations and ATP-dependent dwells cannot by themselves distinguish power strokes from Brownian ratchets; a tightly coupled ratchet can show the same regular steps. The proposed central mechanism discriminator is non-identifying. Primary model example: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4052363/ .

Torque and power are conditional, but no torque-angle work versus actual ATP/ADP/phosphate chemical-free-energy experiment or its supported energetic prediction is supplied. Thus the joint historical readout/prediction is incomplete, independently of the exact step angle.
